test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option for blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**biggest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The passage talks about ostriches having the largest eyes among all birds.
 
• The correct superlative form of **big** is **biggest**, used to compare more than two subjects.</s
